title: PRD sign-off: Guardrails & cross-team commitments for model-version pinning
creator: Miguel Santos
description:
Background: The PRD proposes a model-version pinning feature that lets customers pin a specific model+quantization variant to a deployment across Hosted, Dedicated, and Private modes. This ticket coordinates cross-team reviews and documents commitments required for sign-off (engineering implementation constraints, design UX patterns for pinning and fallbacks, and legal/compliance language for contract terms and data residency implications).

Scope clarifications requested: (1) Does pinning include automatic fallback to compatible variants or should fallbacks be opt-in? (2) For Private deployments, is the pin metadata stored in the customer's control plane or the Redwood control plane? (3) What metrics and alerting constitute an acceptable regression threshold post-rollout?

Goal: Obtain formal approvals from Eng/Design/Legal and list concrete acceptance criteria so PM can schedule the feature into the March release train or push back scope if blockers remain.
acceptance_criteria: Eng: Design doc + API spec accepted and linked GitHub implementation tickets created (ENG-2890, ENG-2891, ENG-2892)
Eng: End-to-end integration tests cover pinning, fallback, and telemetry (latency, error-rate, model-mismatch) and pass in CI for hosted/dedicated/private matrices
Design: UX flows for pin creation, editing, and conflict resolution approved; mockups for Console (pin modal, warnings, and canary controls) accepted
Legal: Contract language for pin SLA and responsibilities (e.g., compatibility guarantees) reviewed and approved; privacy/residency impact documented for Private customers
Operational: Rollout playbook exists (canary %s, rollback criteria, alert runbooks) and on-call rotation assigned for the first 72 hours
Monitoring: Dashboards with per-pin latency and token-cost breakdowns created and accessible to Customer Success and SRE
Security: Key management considerations for storing pin metadata in Private mode validated with Security team
tasks: PM: Consolidate PRD clarifications and publish version 1.1 (target 2025-02-18)
ENG: Complete API surface proposal and implications doc (ENG-2890) by 2025-02-20
DES: Deliver final mockups for Console pin flows and error states by 2025-02-19
LEGAL: Provide redlines for contract updates and risk summary by 2025-02-21
SRE: Draft rollout playbook and alert thresholds by 2025-02-24
PM: Run alignment meeting and capture sign-off matrix (Eng, Design, Legal, Security, SRE) by 2025-02-21
decisions: 2025-02-17: Agreed to make fallback to compatible variants opt-out for Hosted/Dedicated, opt-in for Private (action: ENG to implement flagging)
2025-02-18: Store pin metadata in customer-managed control plane for Private deployments; article to be added to ops docs
2025-02-20: Rollout will use staged canary: 5% -> 25% -> 100% with 6-hour guard windows and automatic rollback on >5% error-rate increase
